name: Methylprednisolone
executiveSummary: Intermediate IV corticosteroid. Adult asthma 40–125 mg IV every 6–8 h; MS flare 1 g/day × 3–5 days. Pediatric anti-inflammatory 1–2 mg/kg/day; pulses 10–30 mg/kg/day (max 1 g) by indication.
indications:
## Indications

- Asthma exacerbation, severe allergic reactions, anaphylaxis (adjunct).
- Pulses in autoimmune disease / glomerulopathies / rejection.
- Acute spinal cord injury (historical regimens — verify current protocol).
- Multiple sclerosis flare (megadose).

## Precautions

- Hyperglycemia, hypertension, ulcer, infections, psychosis. Infuse high doses slowly (arrhythmia with bolus).
- Equivalence: **4 mg methylprednisolone ≈ 5 mg prednisone ≈ 0.75 mg dexamethasone**.

> Pulses only under specialty protocol.

adulto.dose: Asthma / acute inflammation: **40–125 mg IV every 6–8 h** (then step down to PO). MS flare: **1 g IV/day × 3–5 days**. Shock/anaphylaxis (adjunct): **1–2 mg/kg** IV (often 125 mg). Autoimmune pulses: **10–30 mg/kg/day** or **1 g/day** × 3 days per institutional regimen.
adulto.administration: Reconstitute with manufacturer diluent or sterile water. Dilute to 2.5–20 mg/mL in NS (preferred) or 5% dextrose. < 250 mg: ≥ 5 min; ≥ 250 mg: ≥ 30–60 min (up to 120 min for megadose).
adulto.notes: Push max ~125 mg/mL. Antacid prophylaxis at high doses.

pediatrico.dose: Usual anti-inflammatory: **1–2 mg/kg/day** IV divided every 6–12 h (adult-oriented max). Pulses: **10–30 mg/kg/dose** (max **1 g**) × 3 days. Spinal injury (if still used): load **30 mg/kg**, then **5.4 mg/kg/h × 23 h**. Glomerulopathies/rejection: **10 mg/kg/day × 3 days** (max 1 g/dose).
pediatrico.administration: Diluted IV 30–120 min by dose. No rapid megadose bolus.
pediatrico.notes: Dose by weight. Monitor BP, glycemia, and electrolytes.

neonatal.dose: Only pulmonary/DAH or other explicit NNU indications — not a general anti-inflammatory regimen.

stability:
## Stability

- Reconstituted: up to ~48 h at room temperature per many labels (verify).
- Dilution: use within the shift / per manufacturer.
adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Hypertension, hyperglycemia, peptic ulcer, myopathy, growth delay, cataracts, osteoporosis, iatrogenic Cushing, edema, hypokalemia, infections, osteonecrosis.
